hero.title: Hi, I'm Pablo.
hero.intro: Staff AI/ML Engineer from 🇪🇸 Spain, based in 🇹🇼 Taiwan. I build ML systems for semiconductors and music tools for fun.

engineeringFocus.lead: With a background in EECS, I've studied and worked across the US, Spain, Portugal, China, and Taiwan on:

areas.title: Production ML
areas.description: Building and deploying machine learning systems for semiconductors, fraud detection, and e-commerce: from vision models for defect detection to customer segmentation.

areas.title: LLMs & Agents
areas.description: Designing agent workflows, MCPs, and vector databases to help engineers investigate manufacturing defects.

areas.title: Music
areas.description: Research in deep learning for music generation, building electric guitar hardware, and developing tools for musicians.

coffeeChat.title: Say Hi / Coffee Chat
coffeeChat.description: Interested in machine learning, semiconductors, music technology, or life in Taiwan? Feel free to grab a slot on my calendar to chat.
coffeeChat.mentorship: I've also mentored university students through IMFAHE since 2024.
